name: format_graph
purpose: Deterministic headless Sugiyama-lite layered-DAG layout of a K2 graph — fixes '40 spawned nodes heaped at origin' with zero new deps.
engineApi: UEdGraphNode Pins/NodePosX/NodePosY/NodeWidth/NodeHeight/NodeGuid (EdGraphNode.h:278-393); UEdGraphPin LinkedTo/Direction (EdGraphPin.h:378,302); UK2Node::IsNodePure inline (K2Node.h:241); UEdGraphSchema_K2::PC_Exec (EdGraphSchema_K2.h:354); FEdGraphUtilities::CalculateApproximateNodeBoundaries UNREALED_API (EdGraphUtilities.h:130)
cooked: cooked .pak Blueprints have stripped graphs (0 nodes) — behaves as '0 layout-able nodes'; full on loose and kr_*-reconstructed assets (primary customer)
hazards: Cyclic exec links via reroutes possible — break cycles at back-edges (BFS visited set), report cyclesBroken, never hang

Export-claim corrected: UEdGraphNode is MinimalAPI and UEdGraphPin unexported — fine, only public data members + COREUOBJECT_API Modify needed (same write path as move_node, MifBridgeNodes.cpp:678-693)

name: format_graph_ba_request
purpose: Pixel-quality format identical to pressing BlueprintAssist Format-All — real measured sizes; Plan A, requires editor UI open.
cooked: refuses usefully — cooked-stripped graphs have no nodes; kr_* reconstructed BPs work (real loose UBlueprints)
hazards: MUST NOT run under blanket RunEndpoint transaction — FormatAllEvents opens its own multi-frame FScopedTransaction (BlueprintAssistGraphHandler.cpp:3350)
Couples MifBridge to a marketplace plugin — guard with Build.cs directory-existence check WITH_BLUEPRINT_ASSIST so bridge builds without BA
BA silently returns null formatters on read-only graphs (cpp:3426) — detect via zero moved nodes
Single-flight: second format job while one active must be refused
BA attach latency after editor-open unbounded from static reading — timeoutSec=30 needs live tuning (UNVERIFIED)

name: format_graph_ba_status
purpose: Poll the Plan-A BA format job — phase, size progress, transaction state, moved-node diff vs request-time snapshot, bounds.
hazards: GetFormattingChangeData (h:184) deliberately unused — FBAFormattingChangeData has no export macro (BlueprintAssistNodeSizeChangeData.h:77), would not link; snapshot-diff instead

name: fit_comment_to_nodes
purpose: Compute union rect of a node set and set comment bounds + membership so agent-made comments behave like human comments.
cooked: loose/reconstructed assets only — stripped graphs have nothing to fit around
prevents: add_comment writes x/y/width/height blindly with no membership (MifBridgeNodes4.cpp:316-337)
hazards: NodesUnderComment is a PRIVATE non-UPROPERTY member (EdGraphNode_Comment.h:119-122) — membership is session-transient, not asset-serialized and not transaction-captured; ASC cache sync is the ONLY persistence, upgrading that dependency to strongly-recommended
list_object_properties cannot verify membership — verify via exported GetNodesUnderComment().Num() echoed as contained:N

name: export_graph_text
purpose: Lossless T3D (clipboard-format) export of a graph or node subset — exact pin defaults, positions, classes; export only, no import.
cooked: stripped graphs export empty node list — return nodes:0, text:"" with cookedStripped:true note; full fidelity on loose/reconstructed assets
hazards: CRASH hazard: ExportNodesToText contains check((LastOuter==ThisOuter)||(LastOuter==NULL)) (EdGraphUtilities.cpp:458-481) — mixed-outer nodes hard-crash; same-graph pre-validation of every nodeGuid is LOAD-BEARING and must run before the engine call
Impl calls UnMarkAllObjects(OBJECTMARK_TagExp|TagImp) — transient global annotation only, read-only bucket stands
